verdict.rationale: PostHog AI is documented as an AI analyst that lives inside PostHog, in a chat sidebar and inline entry points. It does work as well as analysis: it creates dashboards, surveys, alerts and feature flags, edits filters, and starts coding tasks that end in pull requests. The same agent is also reachable from Slack. A hands-on user report notes it could not create a SQL-based cohort and that the input became very sluggish, which is a real limitation but does not contradict the documented core. Missing for 10: independent positive corroboration of delegated tasks, and resolution of the reported UI performance and cohort-creation gaps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: PostHog AI is an AI product analyst that lives inside PostHog.
PostHog AI creates dashboards, surveys, alerts, and feature flags, edits filters in the UI alongside you, and remembers what it learns about your product between conversations.
Ask it a question in plain English and it queries your data, builds the insight, writes the SQL, or finds the session replay – then explains what it found.
have PostHog AI write for you
